name: Giant Rat
extDescription: When this card is sent to the Graveyard as a result of battle, you can Special Summon 1 EARTH monster with an ATK of 1500 or less in face-up Attack Position from your Deck. Then shuffle your Deck.

name: Creature Swap
extDescription: Each player selects 1 monster they control and switches control of those monsters with each other. Those monsters' cannot change their battle positions for the rest of this turn.

name: Trap Hole
extDescription: When your opponent Normal Summons or Flip Summons a monster with an ATK of 1000 points or more, destroy the monster.

name: Spear Dragon
extDescription: During battle between this attacking card and a Defense Position monster whose DEF is lower than the ATK of this card, inflict the difference as Battle Damage to your opponent's Life Points. If this card attacks, it is changed to Defense Position at the end of the Damage Step.

name: Mystic Tomato
extDescription: When this card is sent to the Graveyard as a result of battle, you can Special Summon 1 DARK monster with an ATK of 1500 or less in face-up Attack Position from your Deck. Then shuffle your Deck.

name: Royal Decree
extDescription: While this card is face-up on the field, negate the effects of all Trap Cards on the field except this card.

name: Dark Balter the Terrible
extDescription:
"""Possessed Dark Soul"" + ""Frontier Wiseman""
A Fusion Summon of this monster can only be conducted with the above Fusion Material Monsters. When a Normal Spell Card is activated, negate the effect by paying 1000 Life Points. The effect of an Effect Monster that this monster destroys as a result of battle is negated."
